messages.subject: sliderInput and round=T or round=-1
parts: I encounter a strange behavior using round in sliderInput. If I use round=F then everything works, setting round=T or round=-1 does not draw my UI elements correctly nor it draws my  output plot from the main panel. I found also https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/502 . Any help?

messages.author: c5790e857463cacd
messages.subject: Re: sliderInput and round=T or round=-1
parts:
This may also be related to this issue:  

https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/301

In that case it was the use of both round and step that causes the problem. You can try using the format option instead of round as a workaround.
